newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Aeroflot cargo volume falls in Q1 97 yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Aeroflot cargo volume falls in Q1 97 yr/yr.

text.p: Aeroflot -Russian International cargo volume dropped in the first quarter of this year to 18,424 tonnes from 21,089 tonnes for the same period in 1996, a company spokesman said on Wednesday.
He declined to comment on the reasons for the fall.

The spokesman said that Bejing was Aeroflot's top export cargo destination on its scheduled flights from Moscow in 1996. Zurich, New York, Hanoi, Singapore and Havana were also among the ten top export freight destinations.
Other top cargo destinations were located in Russia and other Commonwealth of Independent States countries.
Aeroflot did not say how many tonnes of cargo were transported to each destination. --Viktor Anoshkin, Moscow Newsroom, +7095 941 8520
